ai.seo_question: What is the abode of the Taghut in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Taghut' encompasses not only tyrannical rulers but also any entity worshipped or obeyed in defiance of God, making this phrase a universal declaration of their spiritual and physical ruin. The term 'Ma'ab' (return/destination) underscores the inevitability of their end, contrasting the transient nature of worldly power with the eternal abode of Hell. This concept is central to the narrative of divine justice, where the ultimate victory belongs to the righteous against all forms of despotism.
